column1: #   a mixin definition .name(...) { } at the top level or in a namespace -> function
#   an @variable or detached ruleset at the top level of the file -> variable
#   a custom property (--x: v), each declaration -> variable
#   a top-level rule set whose entire selector is one bare .class or #id -> class
#     (this includes #namespace, and a .class{} that is later called as a mixin)
# Not definitions: @variables inside a rule or @media block, mixin calls (.rounded();),
# nested and interpolated selectors (&-title, .@{x}-wide), compound selectors (.btn:hover),
